svg.text: The same stack drawn as what it is: a loop. Six stages, and the only one that improves it is stage five.
transcripts come from SQL, not the API
one direct message for the TL;DR
indexed, re-read on every later run
the only step that teaches it anything
the repo is the source of truth
all of it through dbt MCP
a schedule that outlives its skill
The inventory changes every few weeks. The shape has not changed since it was first drawn — which is the point worth keeping.
